source: A replay of a demonstration scan. Figures and sentences are quoted from https://ai-scan.northidaholabs.com/visit.html as read on 2026-11-09. No party signed any line, and three lines were never part of the scan.

lines.reason: The tolerance gives no allowance for 14.6 m of height.

evidence.say: 4.1 mm out of plumb (3/16 in) over 14.6 m. The top leans toward the side it was scanned from. The tolerance gives no allowance for 14.6 m of height. Flat to 7.6 mm RMS.

lines.reason: The face never came back into view.

evidence.say: 16.2 m, from the ground at its foot to the parapet the scan saw.
23 places of 0.5 m² or more, 10 mm or deeper.
All 19 stations in one frame. The most any two overlapping stations disagree is 22 mm.
